course_aims: ECON2560 aims to familiarise students with basic issues on economic development and globalization. It allows students to develop a solid knowledge of developing economies and their pressing issues.

learning_outcomes.description: Differentiate between developed and developing countries by analysing current conditions, such as labour markets, poverty and seasonality.
Explain the impact of globalization on poverty, inequality, and growth in the developing world.
Analyse the development policy-making process recognizing the relative roles of the market, state, and civil society.
Analyse how the unique environment faced by households in the developing world shapes their behaviour.
Explain how we measure development outcomes, with a focus on the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

assessment_details.title: Journal article review
assessment_details.task_description: Journal Article Review (JAR) Guidelines and Instructions Word Limit: 1480 - 1520 words (excluding references in the list, in-text references, and section headings) . Review ONE Journal Article of Your Choice. The articles that you choose will need to have prior approval from the course coordinator by 5 pm (BRISBANE TIME (GMT+10 HOURS) on 1 September 2026 at the latest. JAR constitutes a critically important building block in learning outcomes for this course and complements other components of assessment in ECON2560, especially the Country Report . You are required to complete this task individually, not in a group. Students may send in a draft Review for feedback prior to the due date. Read full task description Hide full task description
